title: 第十四章 此乃剑中天子
content_zh:
赵汝成那占地近十亩的豪宅中，两个身影在剑光中倏忽分合。
赵汝成手中一震，长剑脱手而飞。而姜望的长剑已停在他的脖颈旁，正似笑非笑地看着他。
“好厉害！”赵汝成惊叹不已，“这是什么剑术？”
他与姜望的剑术自是有些差距的，但也没有太大。往日切磋斗剑，十场里他总能赢回三五场，而今日连斗二十场，竟一场未胜！
姜望笑笑收剑，这门剑术不愧是以武入道的玄妙法门。共有练法九式，杀法五式。他如今甚至只掌握了四式练法，一式杀法，对剑术的理解便已远胜之前。
他自忖战力已堪入品，若再遇到那晚袭击的妖人，定有一战之力。
“这门剑术是我机缘所得，并没有什么名目。汝成你文武皆通，你说叫什么好？”
赵汝成略一沉吟，“此乃剑中天子，当名……紫气东来。”
“紫气东来……”姜望目中有异彩一闪而过，“好名字！”
刚才那一瞬间，他似乎看到赵汝成身上某种此前未见的雄阔气度。
但大概是错觉，因为赵汝成下一刻便捡起跌落的长剑，跳到姜望面前，仍是那副混不吝的样子，嬉皮笑脸道：“三哥教我！”
“好。”姜望灿烂一笑。
两人都是凡俗中的剑术高手，不会不懂紫气东来剑诀的珍贵。它完全不同于那些流传于俗世的技击之术，而是足以以武入道的超凡剑典。
那些强大的剑修们，可丝毫不输给道术高手。
这样一部剑典，在江湖上足以引起腥风血雨。但这两人一个坦然要学，一个随性便教。倒显得这剑典无足轻重了。
姜望回到道院时，天色已晚。
除了有课业的时候，赵汝成一般是不待在道院里的，十足纨绔性子。
脑海里揣摩着紫气东来剑诀的奥妙，以至于走到内院宿舍门口的时候，才看到抱剑而立的黎剑秋。
“想什么呢，这么入神？”黎剑秋似笑非笑。
“一些剑术上的问题。”姜望坦然以对，问道：“黎师兄所为何来？”

“难怪姜师弟剑术惊人。”黎剑秋随口赞叹了一句，才道：“董师让你明日晨课后去他那里一趟，我见你不在宿舍，便等了阵。”
“啊，我整个下午都在汝成的府里。”姜望有些不好意思，“怎敢劳黎师兄等候？您留句话给侍者便行了。”
内门弟子是有专人服侍的，包办衣食，以让这些道门种子专心修行。
“董师既是令我通知你，便不可假手于人。我也不是什么名门贵胄，高贵到等个人都不行。”
姜望微微低头，“小弟忐忑。”
他的确忐忑，要知道黎剑秋比他高上两届，在那一届里也是秀出群伦的几个人之一。板上钉钉将来会去清河郡院进修，是整个城院里数得着的英才。
而这样一个人物，却在宿舍门前站着等他，毫无急躁之气。
黎剑秋拍了拍姜望的肩，“我看姜师弟前途不可限量，不要如此生分才是。”
说罢他便转身离去。
一夜无话。第二日早课刚毕，姜望便去了董阿的住处。
小院中除了黎剑秋外，还有两人，其中一个也是师兄，名为张临川。出身枫林城三大姓里的张家，其人隐隐是城院弟子中最强的几个人之一，声名颇著。
他外貌倒不算十分英俊，但也长身玉立，自有风度。衣衫垂饰，无不精致妥帖。
此刻他站在院中，正听旁边的人说着什么。
而院中剩下的另一人，竟是方鹤翎。
瞥得姜望进来，他故意放大了声音，“张世兄！昨日里我庄里的猎户送来一对好熊掌，明天我请望月楼的大厨好生整治一番，到时候咱们一块儿尝尝。”
张临川微笑着点头。
方鹤翎又转头邀道：“黎师兄也同去！”
黎剑秋也不拂他的面子，只笑了笑，“有空便去。”
不等方鹤翎继续奉承，黎剑秋便往院门方向走了几步，“姜师弟来了？”
竟是特意迎了一迎。

姜望慌忙赶了几步，招呼道：“不好意思，我来晚了。”
【送红包】号【书友大本营】抽红包！
他走到黎剑秋身边，又对张临川拱手为礼：“张师兄好。”
也唯独对方鹤翎视如不见。
“你也好。”张临川淡笑点头，似乎对姜方二人之间的暗涌毫无察觉。
但有的人便是一定要凸显存在的。
“哼。”方鹤翎极为突兀地哼了一声，才阴阳怪气道：“董师有了吩咐，连张师兄黎师兄都早早赶来，我更是早课都来不及去，一起床便赶来了。也不知某些人何德何能，竟敢让董师和两位师兄等着他？”
姜望仍不理他，只对黎剑秋和张临川抱了抱拳，“小弟刚结束早课便赶来了，绝非怠慢师命。只是早课晚课，诵经吐纳。晨钟暮鼓，须臾不敢懈怠。”
黎剑秋再次拍了拍姜望的肩膀，以示亲近：“无妨，是我们来得早了，而不是你来得晚。修行之路的确容不得懈怠，我与张师兄虽然不用去经院与师弟们一起诵经，可早课也是在房里便做了的。”
方鹤翎心中更恼，但有黎剑秋表态，他倒不敢再煽风。
这时只听吱呀一声，却是董阿推门而出。
“都来了？”他环视一周，不怒自威。
四人俱行道礼，“董师！”
董阿摆摆手，他是一个干脆果决的性子，不喜拖拉，当即便道：“今天唤你们来，是有一件任务交付你们。之前妖人袭击外院，残杀一名外门弟子的事情你们应该都知道。缉刑司查了这么久也没个结果。咱们城道院的事情倒也不用非得等着人家处理，便着你们去查这件事，以八品任务标准计勋。”
与外门任务不同，内门任务便开始定品，通常品级随任务中所接触的最强战力定品。并且奖励计量单位也不再是贡献度，而是道勋。
难度是天壤之别，奖励自然也有如云泥。以开脉丹为例。外门贡献度要到天量才能换取，道勋却只需一百点。
当然，一百点道勋也并不容易得到便是了。
单以这次左道妖人袭击外院来说，妖人表现出来的实力只在九品范围内。董阿将其定为八品，显然有些鼓励性质。.. c o
“姜望方鹤翎是这届目前唯二道脉外显的弟子，须得好生磨砺。临川、剑秋你们修行时日更长，可带着两个师弟分头去查。任务奖励一九分成，哪边先查到，哪边得九成。”
张临川与黎剑秋都躬身，“谨遵师命。”

董阿大袖一摆便自顾回门了，显然不打算对接下来的事情插手。
张临川显然有备而来，略一沉吟，便道：“我在缉刑司有朋友，这次妖人袭击事件有两条线索最有用。一个是妖人袭击之前，曾在福来客栈住了三天，应有些线索留下。另一个，便是唐舍镇里有一户人家被灭门，现场留有尸气，与袭击咱们外院的妖人有些相似。黎师弟你选哪一路？”
黎剑秋道：“这是张师兄的情报，自然听凭张师兄分配。”
张临川毫不意外，黎剑秋但凡有些脑子，也不会在这时便与他争抢。他说这些，也只是走个过场罢了。当下便点点头，“如此，我去唐舍镇，黎师弟去福来客栈。”
站在张临川旁边的方鹤翎眼睛都亮了，“有张师兄出马，区区左道妖人，何所遁形？”
语罢还瞥了一眼姜望，颇为得意。
明眼人都看得出来，唐舍镇更符合妖人潜伏的条件，线索也更明朗。在方鹤翎看来，这初出茅庐的第一次八品任务，他便要占得大头了。
这时张临川又对黎剑秋道：“黎师弟，我来带姜望如何？”
黎剑秋不动声色，“也好。”
其实之前众人的站位，便是已经默认了分路的。姜望与黎剑秋熟悉一些，而张临川和方鹤翎同为三大姓出身。
虽然不明白张临川为什么不选择家世更近也更熟悉的方鹤翎，但姜望也没有选择的权利，当下便礼道：“那便麻烦张师兄了。”
张临川与黎剑秋都经验丰富，很快就做好任务分配，以及一些出任务有可能用到的补给。姜望也自觉忙前忙后的帮忙准备。
唯有方鹤翎杵在那里，脸色阵青阵白。
他倒是很有些意见想表达，但一句也说不出口。
content_en:
In Zhao Rucheng's mansion covering an area of ​​nearly ten acres, two figures suddenly separated and reunited in the light of the sword.
Zhao Rucheng's hand shook and his sword flew away. Jiang Wang's long sword had stopped at his neck, looking at him with a smile but not a smile.
"It's amazing!" Zhao Rucheng was amazed, "What kind of swordsmanship is this?"
There is a slight gap between his and Jiang Wang's swordsmanship, but it's not too big. In the past, he would always win three or five out of ten sword fights, but today he had twenty fights in a row and failed to win a single one!
Jiang Wang smiled and sheathed his sword. This swordsmanship was indeed a mysterious method of entering the Tao through martial arts. There are nine exercises for training and five for killing. Now he has only mastered the four-style training method and one-style killing method, and his understanding of swordsmanship is far better than before.
He thought that his fighting ability was of a high standard, and if he encountered the demon who attacked that night again, he would definitely be able to fight.
"This swordsmanship was acquired by chance. It has no name. Rucheng, you are proficient in both civil and military arts. What do you think it should be called?"
Zhao Rucheng pondered for a moment, "This is the Emperor in the Sword, and his name is... Purple Qi is coming from the east."
"Purple Qi is coming from the east..." Something strange flashed across Jiang Wang's eyes, "What a name!"
At that moment, he seemed to see some majesty in Zhao Rucheng that he had never seen before.
But it was probably an illusion, because Zhao Rucheng picked up the fallen sword the next moment, jumped in front of Jiang Wang, still looking like a fool, and said with a playful smile: "Third brother, teach me!"
"Okay." Jiang Wang smiled brightly.
Both of them are mortal swordsman masters, so they will not understand the preciousness of Zi Qi Dong Lai Sword Technique. It is completely different from those martial arts that are spread in the world, but an extraordinary sword code that is enough to enter the Tao through martial arts.
Those powerful sword cultivators are not inferior to Taoist masters at all.
Such a sword canon is enough to cause a bloody storm in the world. But one of them wanted to learn calmly, and the other taught casually. It seems that this sword code is insignificant.
When Jiang Wang returned to the Taoist Temple, it was getting late.
Except when he has schoolwork, Zhao Rucheng usually doesn't stay in the Taoist temple, and he is quite a playboy.
He was pondering the secrets of the Zi Qi Dong Lai Sword Technique in his mind, so that when he walked to the door of the inner courtyard dormitory, he saw Li Jianqiu standing with his sword in his arms.
"What are you thinking about, so entranced?" Li Jianqiu seemed to be smiling but not smiling.
"Some swordsmanship issues." Jiang Wang answered calmly and asked, "Why are senior brothers Li here?"
"No wonder Junior Brother Jiang's swordsmanship is amazing." Li Jianqiu praised casually, and then said: "Master Dong asked you to go to his place after morning class tomorrow. I saw that you were not in the dormitory, so I waited."
"Ah, I have been at Rucheng's house all afternoon." Jiang Wang was a little embarrassed, "How dare you keep Brother Li waiting? Just leave a message for the waiter."
Inner sect disciples have dedicated personnel to serve them and provide food and clothing so that these Taoist seeds can concentrate on their cultivation.
"Since Master Dong has asked me to inform you, you can't do anything to others. I'm not a noble person. I'm not as noble as anyone else."
Jiang Wang lowered his head slightly, "My little brother is worried."
He was really worried, considering that Li Jianqiu was two terms ahead of him, and was one of the few people who stood out in that term. It is certain that he will go to Qinghe County Courtyard for further studies in the future. He is one of the few talents in the entire city courtyard.
But such a person stood waiting for him in front of the dormitory door without any impatience.
Li Jianqiu patted Jiang Wang on the shoulder, "I think Junior Brother Jiang's future is limitless, so don't be so divided."
After saying that, he turned and left.
A night of silence. Just after morning class on the second day, Jiang Wang went to Dong A's residence.
In addition to Li Jianqiu, there are two other people in the small courtyard, one of whom is also a senior, named Zhang Linchuan. Born in the Zhang family, one of the three major surnames in Maplewood City, he is vaguely one of the strongest among the disciples in the city, and he is quite famous.
He is not very handsome in appearance, but he is tall and has his own grace. The hangings on clothes are all exquisite and appropriate.
At this moment, he was standing in the courtyard, listening to what the people next to him were saying.
And what's left in the courtyardThe other person turned out to be Fang Heling.
Seeing Jiang Wang come in, he deliberately raised his voice, "Brother Zhang Shi! Yesterday, the hunter in my village sent a pair of good bear paws. Tomorrow I will ask the chef of Wangyue Tower to clean them up, and then we can taste them together."
Zhang Linchuan smiled and nodded.
Fang Heling turned around and invited: "Senior Brother Li, let's go too!"
Li Jianqiu didn't care about him, just smiled and said, "I'll go when I have time."
Without waiting for Fang Heling to continue flattering, Li Jianqiu took a few steps toward the courtyard gate and asked, "Junior Brother Jiang is here?"
It was actually a special greeting.
Jiang Wang hurriedly took a few steps and greeted, "Sorry, I'm late."
[Send Red Envelopes] Number [Book Friends Base Camp] draws red envelopes!
He walked to Li Jianqiu and bowed his hands to Zhang Linchuan: "Hello, Senior Brother Zhang."
Only Fang Heling turned a blind eye.
"Hello to you too." Zhang Linchuan smiled and nodded, seemingly unaware of the undercurrent between Jiang Fang and the two.
But some people must highlight their existence.
"Hmph." Fang Heling snorted very abruptly, and then said angrily: "Master Dong had an order, and even Senior Brother Zhang and Senior Brother Li came here early. I even didn't have time to go to morning classes, so I came as soon as I got up. I don't know how virtuous and capable some people are, how dare they let Master Dong and two senior brothers wait for him?"
Jiang Wang still ignored him, and only hugged Li Jianqiu and Zhang Linchuan, "My younger brother came here just after morning class. It is definitely not neglecting the teacher's orders. It's just morning class and evening class, chanting sutras and breathing. The bells in the morning and the drums in the evening, I don't dare to slack off for a moment."
Li Jianqiu patted Jiang Wang's shoulder again to show his closeness: "It doesn't matter, it's us who came early, not you who came late. There is no room for slacking off on the path of spiritual practice. Although Senior Brother Zhang and I don't have to go to the seminary to chant sutras with the junior brothers, we still do our morning classes in the room."
Fang Heling was even more annoyed, but with Li Jianqiu's stance, he did not dare to fan the flames any more.
At this moment, there was only a creaking sound, but it was Dong A who pushed the door open and walked out.
"Are they all here?" He looked around, not angry or proud.
The four of them all performed Taoist rituals, "Master Dong!"
Dong A waved his hands. He was a straightforward and resolute person who didn't like procrastination. He said calmly: "I called you here today because I have a task for you. You should all know about the demon attack on the outer courtyard and massacre of an outer disciple. The Criminal Investigation Department has been investigating for so long but there is no result. We don't have to wait for others to deal with matters in our city's Taoist courtyard. I'll let you investigate this matter and calculate the merits according to the standards of eighth-grade tasks."
Different from the outer missions, the inner missions begin to be graded, and usually the grade is determined by the strongest combat power encountered in the mission. And the unit of measurement for rewards is no longer contribution, but Daoxun.
The difficulty is vastly different, and the rewards are naturally as vast as clouds and mud. Take the Pulse Opening Pill as an example. The outer sect's contribution points can only be exchanged for a certain amount of money, but Daoxun only needs one hundred points.
Of course, one hundred points of Daoxun are not easy to obtain.
Taking this time's attack on the outer courtyard by the demon from the Left Dao alone, the demon's strength was only within the ninth level. Dong A designated it as the eighth grade, which is obviously somewhat encouraging. ..c o
"Jiang Wangfang Heling is the only disciple in this class who has two visible channels. He needs to hone himself hard. Linchuan and Jianqiu, you have longer training time, so you can take your two junior brothers to investigate separately. The mission reward is 19%. Whoever finds it first will get 90%."
Zhang Linchuan and Li Jianqiu both bowed and said, "I will obey my master's orders."
Dong Ah waved his sleeves and went back home, obviously not intending to interfere in what happened next.
Zhang Linchuan came clearly prepared. He pondered for a while and said: "I have friends in the Criminal Investigation Department. There are two clues that are most useful for this monster attack. One is that before the monster attack, he stayed at Fulai Inn for three days, so there should be some clues left. The other is that a family in Tangshe Town was wiped out, and there was corpse aura left at the scene, which is somewhat similar to the monster that attacked our outer courtyard. Which path do you choose, Junior Brother Li?"
Li Jianqiu Dao: "This is Senior Brother Zhang's information. Naturally, it is up to Senior Brother Zhang to distribute it."
Zhang Linchuan was not surprised. If Li Jianqiu had some brains, he would not compete with him at this time. What he said was just going through the motions. He nodded immediately, "In this case, I will go to Tangshe Town, and Junior Brother Li will go to Fulai Inn."
Standing next to Zhang Linchuan, Fang Heling's eyes lit up, "With Senior Brother Zhang taking action, how can a mere evil demon hide away?"
After speaking, he glanced at Jiang Wang, feeling quite proud.
Anyone with a discerning eye can see that Tangshe Town is more in line with the conditions for a demon to lurk, and the clues are clearer. In Fang Heling's view, he was going to take the lion's share of this first eighth-level mission.
At this time, Zhang Linchuan said to Li Jianqiu again: "Junior brother Li, how about I take Jiang Wang?"
Li Jianqiu said calmly, "That's fine."
In fact, everyone's previous positions had already defaulted to the split route. Jiang Wang and Li Jianqiu are familiar with each other, while Zhang Linchuan and Fang Heling are from the same three major surnames.
Although he didn't understand why Zhang Linchuan didn't choose Fang Heling, who had a closer family background and was more familiar to him, Jiang Wang didn't have the right to choose. He said politely: "Then I'll trouble Senior Brother Zhang."
Both Zhang Linchuan and Li Jianqiu were experienced and quickly assigned tasks and supplies that might be needed for the mission. Jiang Wang also consciously worked hard to help prepare.
Only Fang Heling was there, his face turning green and white.
He had some opinions that he wanted to express, but he couldn't say a word.
